assumptions: All runs require uninterrupted process/no counter reset and isolated C4 requests. r19b explicit before/after is active0 and requests_total6->10; r18 likewise. r17 retained post-canary baseline has matching request-count delta.

The repaired generic MTP path is selected with fixed two drafts, no active grammar or adaptation changing depth. CLI max drafts2, repair1, depth-adapt0, isolated env and ladder clamp for <=4 owners support this; Done depth=k3 alone would not prove every step depth.

Every request has one initial non-verifying bootstrap and terminates on a verifier. Two drafts generated per actual verify; no abandoned/error proposals included. Four omitted terminal counters plus four bootstraps exactly reconcile with independently recovered accounting steps.

Done lines are associated with request rows through unique server usage TTFT rounded to 0.1ms. Rounded mean_na and p1 each admit exactly one integer count for the known accepted total. These reconstructed integers are not directly logged counters.

Accepted usage counts accepted seq_len growth before output-cap emission, including accepted positions at terminal verification that might not all be emitted. Proposal rejection here means not in the accepted prefix, not necessarily a wrong token independently evaluated after the first mismatch.
For r20, explicit active=0 boundaries, request delta4, decoded delta1600 and four matched Done lines support isolation; these checks do not create direct per-request proposal telemetry.
One matched trial per candidate. Output text and routing/acceptance can differ; this does not establish quality equivalence or identify the cause of the acceptance change.
missing_telemetry: Request-scoped proposed/verified count and actual depth histogram
Terminal-inclusive outcome counters and accepted-prefix histogram
Accepted tokens emitted versus accepted positions beyond output cap
Wire rejected_prediction_tokens is hardcoded zero, not observed rejection

method.accounting_steps_search: Unique integer n in 1..402 with abs(accepted/n - rounded Done mean_na) < 0.000500001; tok_step independently equals rounded 1+accepted/n.
method.first_matches_search: Unique integer d1 in 0..n with abs(d1/n - rounded Done p1) < 0.000500001.
method.done_to_request_match: Unique server usage TTFT within 0.050001 ms of Done TTFT rounded to 0.1 ms; every 400-token Done line is used exactly once.
method.verifies: Counter delta all + partial + four omitted terminal verifies = sum(accounting steps) - four bootstraps.
method.proposal_positions: Two fixed drafts multiplied by reconstructed verifies; never use rejected_prediction_tokens=0 or accepted/output as acceptance.

reference_counter_limitation.scope: Warmup, three captures and semantic suite together, per retained RESULT.md; not isolated C4
